articles.title: South Korean exchanges halt CYBER transfers amid suspected bridge exploit
articles.snippet: Cyber reported unexpected minting of CYBER tokens on Solana, followed by tokens moving out of its Ethereum bridge lockbox, prompting an investigation.

articles.title: Wrapped Monero token crashes 99.8% amid suspected $13.5M exploit
articles.snippet: Bitquery traced $13.5 million in suspicious sales of the wrapped Monero token, as its operator blamed a security breach and promised to reimburse affected traders.

articles.title: Google's Genie 4 Is Here, Letting Ultra Subscribers Build AI Worlds in Real Time
articles.snippet: Google's Genie 4 lets Ultra subscribers reshape interactive scenes while exploring them, complete with sound and dialogue, as Project Genie adds longer sessions and new community creation and sharing tools.
